# Language features (generated)

<!-- Generated by `cargo test -p archipel-ide-language --test feature_matrix`; run with `UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1` to refresh. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every grammar is tier G0 (syntax only) plus file-local resolution where `locals.scm` exists (G1 data, unlocked by the resolve package). Cells count the patterns of the language's query file; `-` means the feature falls back to the generic grammar walk or is not meaningful for the language.

## Features served by the services

| Feature | Source | Languages |
|---|---|---|
| Fold regions, collapse by default, region markers | `folds.scm`, `#set! collapsed`, `@fold.marker` | 21/21 |
| Structure, breadcrumbs, modifiers, details | `tags.scm` (`@modifier`, `@detail`), `doc.scm` (`@doc.skip`) | 21/21 |
| Matching brace, code block start/end, angle and tag pairs | `brackets.scm` | 19/21 |
| Extend/shrink selection with list groups | `textobjects.scm` (`@select.group`) | 21/21 (+ the grammar walk for all) |
| Enter indentation, Auto-Indent Lines, re-indent on `}` | `indents.scm` | 19/21 |
| Sticky scopes | `sticky.scm` + multi-line `tags.scm` definitions | 21/21 |
| Next/Previous Method | `tags.scm` functions and methods | 21/21 |
| Move Statement | `@select.group` elements | 21/21 |
| Complete Current Statement | statement style in the data row | 13/21 |
| Comment with Block Comment | block comment in the data row | 15/21 |
| Syntax-aware auto-pairs, overtype, wrap selection | data row + syntax context | 21/21 |
| Auto-close markup tags | `html`, `xml` | 2/2 |
| File-local resolve data | `locals.scm` | 21/21 |
| Doc comment association | `doc.scm` | 21/21 |
